Overview.Name: Jaya Lakshmi Athram
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Idli (2) & sambar (no potato, no brinjal) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) (pan-cooked) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & paneer curry (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (onion & tomato & lemon & salt)
Option 2: Roasted makhana (hand-roasted in ghee) (salt & chilli powder)
Meal_3: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan-cooked) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 2: Clear vegetable soup (no potato) & 1 chapati

Notes_and_Tips: PCOS support: keep meals protein-forward (eggs/chicken/fish/paneer) with ~1 cup cooked rice (~150 g) to support stable energy.
Sweet & fried cravings: use fruit or curd first, and keep makhana as your crunchy option instead of fried snacks.
Allergy reminder: avoid soy, potatoes and brinjal in curries and side dishes.
Shift-work tip: keep meal timings consistent even on shifts (set 3 fixed slots).
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing support satiety and better insulin control.
